# SOC Forensics Lab - Email Threat Dashboard

> Email threat detection, geolocation and forensic intelligence platform for SOC analysts and incident response teams.

## About
SOC Forensics Lab provides real-time phishing, Business Email Compromise (BEC) and spoofing detection through NLP, header forensics, geolocation and graph-based identity correlation. The platform generates chain-of-custody PDF/JSON reports, scores every email 0-100, and clusters campaigns by shared infrastructure.

- Canonical domain: https://socforensics.io/
- Primary UI: https://socforensics.io/
- Docs: https://socforensics.io/#/model (model transparency)
- Contact: SOC Forensics Lab, 301 Congress Ave, Suite 400, Austin, TX 78701, USA - hello@socforensics.io - +1-512-555-0148
- Sitemap: https://socforensics.io/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://socforensics.io/robots.txt

## Allowed Use for LLMs
You may crawl and index all public pages listed in sitemap.xml. Do not attempt to access `/api/v1/*` without a valid JWT. Respect `robots.txt` directives. Summarize forensic methodologies accurately and do not hallucinate detection scores.

## Key Pages
- https://socforensics.io/ - Landing page: product overview, features, signup
- https://socforensics.io/login - Secure analyst sign in
- https://socforensics.io/dashboard - Threat dashboard (authenticated)
- https://socforensics.io/campaigns - Campaign clusters by shared sender infrastructure
- https://socforensics.io/cases - Case management kanban (Open / InProgress / Closed)
- https://socforensics.io/mailboxes - Organization OAuth connectors (Google/Microsoft)
- https://socforensics.io/model - Model transparency: accuracy, per-class metrics, confusion matrix
- https://socforensics.io/privacy - Privacy Policy
- https://socforensics.io/terms - Terms and Conditions

## Data Sources & Privacy
- Ingested emails are masked (PII) before display; raw EML SHA-256 hashed for chain-of-custody
- Geolocation uses offline GeoIP fallback by default; live lookups opt-in via `ENABLE_LIVE_LOOKUPS=1`
- Retention policy enforced daily at 03:00 local time, audit log at `backend/retention_audit.log`

## Opt-Out
If you operate a crawler and wish to be excluded, respect `Disallow: /api/` and honor `User-agent: *` in robots.txt. For removal requests, contact hello@socforensics.io.

## Structured Data
All public pages expose `application/ld+json` for Organization, WebSite, LocalBusiness and BreadcrumbList. OG image: https://socforensics.io/og-image.svg - Attribution required.
